nodes.name: 📧 Normalize Email
nodes.notes:
Extracts real customer address from replyTo / ccRecipients / 'Отправлено от …' / from.
Sets skip=true for drafts, own-address emails, empty bodies, or non-Tooba-Feedback subjects.

nodes.name: ✅ Should Process
nodes.notes:
TRUE  (skip=true)  → output 0 → dead end — no Slack, no OpenAI.
FALSE (skip=false) → output 1 → 💬 Post Email to Slack.
